deviations.reason: The guard fails because .claude/CLAUDE.md has a pre-existing uncommitted diff from an unrelated prior task (855's rule registration), not from this task's work. Confirmed via `git log --oneline -1 -- .claude/CLAUDE.md` (last commit touching it was task 855, not any commit in this task's chain) and `git show --stat` on this task's phase 1-3 commits (neither touches .claude/CLAUDE.md). All other Phase 3 verification assertions pass, including the substantive ones (rule mentioned in EXTENSION.md and README.md, no live .claude/rules/ copy forged, no leak into core claudemd merge-source, doc-lint exits 0). This is a pre-existing dirty-tree condition outside this task's scope, not a violation of Decision 2.
